description: Fix the findings in security-audit.md (re-reviewed and re-verified 2026-08-09; every finding stands). Each story names its finding ID; read that section of security-audit.md before starting, it has exact file:line references and a fix direction. Cut this branch from `audit`. STANDING RULES for every story: (1) Typecheck with plain `npx tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit`; the only allowed pre-existing error is the known TS2769 in test/test-vectors/key-schedule.ts. The Worker typecheck `npx tsc -p example-realistic-demo/tsconfig.json --noEmit` must be completely clean. (2) Check lint's EXIT CODE; piping to tail takes the pipeline status from tail, not eslint. (3) NEVER run a bare `pkill -f wrangler` or `pkill -f workerd`; this machine runs Cloudflare dev servers for other repos. Kill only by path: `pkill -f "/Users/nick/code/webcrypto-mls/node_modules"`, confirm with `pgrep -fl "/Users/nick/code/webcrypto-mls"`. (4) `npm test` takes over 10 minutes; for realistic-demo-only changes use the fast esbuild bundle recipe in HANDOFF.md (~3 seconds). (5) Before claiming a test verifies a fix, break the code it covers and confirm the test goes red; restore by file copy, not `git checkout --`. (6) Do not deploy the Worker. (7) No em dashes and no arrow characters in docs or comments; use `--` and `->`. TypeScript lines stay within 80 columns. (8) This library has downstream API consumers: record every breaking change in CHANGELOG.md in the story that makes it.

userStories.notes: Both halves of the option: defaultClientConfig now carries failClosedAuthenticationService, which throws a UsageError naming the opt-in, and the accept-all behavior survives as unsafeAcceptAllAuthenticationService.
